spec.description: Automation runs with timings, writes and errors, the credits automation charges drew beside the AWS cost of the usage, and the cost coverage report.

panels.description: Switched-on automations in the active state: the tick schedules the next run of each one. The realm, automation and payer filters narrow the count. The Paused and Waiting for credits stats count the other switched-on automations.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active
  FROM automations a
 WHERE a.state = 'active'
   AND ('__all' IN ($realm) OR a.realm IN ($realm))
   AND ('__all' IN ($automation) OR a.automation_id IN ($automation))
   AND ('__all' IN ($payer) OR a.payer IN ($payer));

panels.title: Active automations

targets.rawSql:

 WHERE a.state = 'paused'
   AND ('__all' IN ($realm) OR a.realm IN ($realm))
   AND ('__all' IN ($automation) OR a.automation_id IN ($automation))
   AND ('__all' IN ($payer) OR a.payer IN ($payer));

panels.title: Paused

panels.title: Runs running

panels.description: How long the oldest automation run a worker could claim has waited: from the creation of the run's job, or from the end of the job's last attempt when a worker lost an attempt. The query leaves out a run waiting behind a running run of the same automation (the same concurrency group) or behind a claim hold, since no worker could claim such a run yet. The stat turns red past 5 minutes, the threshold of the "Automation runs waiting for a worker" alert, which runs the same query. The dashboard's filters do not narrow the oldest wait.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - min(waiting.since)), 0) AS oldest_wait_seconds
  FROM (
    SELECT GREATEST(
             j.created_at,
             (SELECT max(COALESCE(r.completed_at, r.locked_until))
                FROM job_reservations r WHERE r.job_id = j.id)
           ) AS since
      FROM jobs j
     WHERE j.status = 'unfulfilled'
       AND j.job_type = 'run-command'
       AND j.concurrency_group LIKE 'automation:%'
       AND NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM job_reservations r
              WHERE r.job_id = j.id
                AND r.completed_at IS NULL
                AND r.locked_until > now())
       AND NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM jobs held
               JOIN job_reservations hr ON hr.job_id = held.id
                AND hr.completed_at IS NULL
                AND hr.locked_until > now()
              WHERE held.status = 'unfulfilled'
                AND held.concurrency_group = j.concurrency_group)
       AND NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM job_claim_holds ch
              WHERE ch.concurrency_group = j.concurrency_group
                AND ch.expires_at > now())
  ) waiting;

panels.title: Errors

panels.description: Scheduled slots coming due while a scheduled run of the same automation still waited to start. The tick joins each such slot to the pending run instead of starting a new run, and the pending run catches up on everything since the automation's last run.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS skipped
  FROM automation_run_log g
  JOIN automation_runs r ON r.id = g.run_id
 WHERE g.kind = 'trigger'
   AND (g.data->>'skipped')::boolean
   AND $__timeFilter(g.at)
   AND ('__all' IN ($realm) OR r.realm IN ($realm))
   AND ('__all' IN ($automation) OR r.automation_id IN ($automation))
   AND ('__all' IN ($payer) OR r.acts_as IN ($payer))
   AND ('__all' IN ($trigger) OR r.trigger IN ($trigger));

panels.title: Skipped slots

panels.description: Credits automation charges drew in the time range: each run's compute and network, the indexing each run's writes caused, each run's AI requests, and daily storage.

targets.rawSql:
WITH charges AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(l.charge_id, l.id) AS charge_id,
         l.charge_kind,
         l.pricing_version,
         l.created_at,
         l.realm,
         l.run_id,
         COALESCE(l.automation_id, r.automation_id) AS automation_id,
         r.trigger,
         u.matrix_user_id AS payer,
         -SUM(l.credit_amount) AS credits
    FROM credits_ledger l
    LEFT JOIN automation_runs r ON r.id = l.run_id
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = l.user_id
   WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(l.created_at)
     AND (l.charge_kind IN ('run', 'run_indexing', 'storage', 'batched_ai')
          OR (l.charge_kind = 'ai' AND l.run_id IS NOT NULL))
   GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9
),
costed AS (
  SELECT charges.*, c.cost_usd
    FROM charges
    LEFT JOIN credit_charge_costs c
      ON c.charge_id = charges.charge_id
     AND $__unixEpochFilter(c.created_at)
   WHERE ('__all' IN ($realm) OR charges.realm IN ($realm))
     AND ('__all' IN ($automation) OR charges.automation_id IN ($automation))
     AND ('__all' IN ($payer) OR charges.payer IN ($payer))
     AND ('__all' IN ($trigger) OR charges.trigger IN ($trigger))
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(credits), 0) AS credits FROM costed;

panels.title: Pricing versions

panels.description: Runs created in each interval, by each run's current state. A finished run reads complete, error or canceled; pending and running are runs still in flight.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.created_at, $__interval, 0),
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.state = 'complete')::int AS "complete",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.state = 'error')::int AS "error",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.state = 'canceled')::int AS "canceled",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.state = 'running')::int AS "running",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.state = 'pending')::int AS "pending"
  FROM automation_runs r
 WHERE $__timeFilter(r.created_at)
   AND ('__all' IN ($realm) OR r.realm IN ($realm))
   AND ('__all' IN ($automation) OR r.automation_id IN ($automation))
   AND ('__all' IN ($payer) OR r.acts_as IN ($payer))
   AND ('__all' IN ($trigger) OR r.trigger IN ($trigger))
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Runs by state

panels.description: Runs ending as an error in each interval, by error_reason. An admission refusal (insufficient-credits, a credit cap, a credential) ends a run before the script starts; timed-out, run-failed and script-error come from the script. The automation-diagnostics skill walks through each reason.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.finished_at, $__interval, 0),
       COALESCE(r.error_reason, 'unknown') AS metric,
       COUNT(*)::int AS value
  FROM automation_runs r
 WHERE r.state = 'error'
   AND $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
   AND ('__all' IN ($realm) OR r.realm IN ($realm))
   AND ('__all' IN ($automation) OR r.automation_id IN ($automation))
   AND ('__all' IN ($payer) OR r.acts_as IN ($payer))
   AND ('__all' IN ($trigger) OR r.trigger IN ($trigger))
 GROUP BY 1, 2
 ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: Errors by reason

panels.description: For runs ending in each interval: the time from a worker claiming the run to the run's end (started → finished), and the whole run from enqueue to end (created → finished), which adds the queue wait.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.finished_at, $__interval, NULL),
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r.finished_at - r.started_at)) AS "run p50",
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r.finished_at - r.started_at)) AS "run p95",
       MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r.finished_at - r.started_at)) AS "run max",
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r.finished_at - r.created_at)) AS "enqueue to end p95"
  FROM automation_runs r
 WHERE r.finished_at IS NOT NULL
   AND r.started_at IS NOT NULL
   AND $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
   AND ('__all' IN ($realm) OR r.realm IN ($realm))
   AND ('__all' IN ($automation) OR r.automation_id IN ($automation))
   AND ('__all' IN ($payer) OR r.acts_as IN ($payer))
   AND ('__all' IN ($trigger) OR r.trigger IN ($trigger))
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Run time

panels.description: Queue wait: the time from the queue receiving a run's job to a worker's first claim of the job, for jobs the queue received in each interval and a worker has claimed. A long wait means a backlog on the automation lane, or the automation's previous run still holding the concurrency group. Schedule lag: the time from a scheduled run's slot to the tick enqueuing the run; a late tick makes the lag grow. The Oldest unclaimed automation run stat covers runs no worker has claimed yet.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(j.created_at, $__interval, NULL),
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM fr.claimed_at - j.created_at)) AS "queue wait p50",
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM fr.claimed_at - j.created_at)) AS "queue wait p95",
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r.created_at - r.slot::timestamptz))
         FILTER (WHERE r.trigger <> 'manual' AND r.slot ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T') AS "schedule lag p95"
  FROM jobs j
  JOIN automation_runs r ON r.id::text = j.args->'commandInput'->>'runId'
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT MIN(jr.created_at) AS claimed_at
      FROM job_reservations jr WHERE jr.job_id = j.id
  ) fr ON fr.claimed_at IS NOT NULL
 WHERE j.job_type = 'run-command'
   AND j.concurrency_group LIKE 'automation:%'
   AND $__timeFilter(j.created_at)
   AND ('__all' IN ($realm) OR r.realm IN ($realm))
   AND ('__all' IN ($automation) OR r.automation_id IN ($automation))
   AND ('__all' IN ($payer) OR r.acts_as IN ($payer))
   AND ('__all' IN ($trigger) OR r.trigger IN ($trigger))
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Queue wait and schedule lag

panels.description: Scheduled slots the tick joined to a pending run of the same automation instead of starting a new run, by trigger. Steady skips mean runs wait longer than the schedule's interval; compare with Queue wait.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(g.at, $__interval, 0),
       COALESCE(g.data->>'trigger', r.trigger) AS metric,
       COUNT(*)::int AS value
  FROM automation_run_log g
  JOIN automation_runs r ON r.id = g.run_id
 WHERE g.kind = 'trigger'
   AND (g.data->>'skipped')::boolean
   AND $__timeFilter(g.at)
   AND ('__all' IN ($realm) OR r.realm IN ($realm))
   AND ('__all' IN ($automation) OR r.automation_id IN ($automation))
   AND ('__all' IN ($payer) OR r.acts_as IN ($payer))
   AND ('__all' IN ($trigger) OR r.trigger IN ($trigger))
 GROUP BY 1, 2
 ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: Skipped slots

panels.description: Runs a worker had claimed and not yet ended, at each instant. A prerender tab carries one run at a time, so the count equals the run tabs in use across the prerender servers; the Prerender capacity row below breaks the count down per server.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t AS time,
       COUNT(r.id)::int AS "runs in flight"
  FROM generate_series(
         date_bin('$__interval'::interval, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'epoch'::timestamptz),
         $__timeTo()::timestamptz,
         '$__interval'::interval) AS t
  LEFT JOIN automation_runs r
    ON r.started_at <= t
   AND COALESCE(r.finished_at, now()) > t
   AND r.started_at <= $__timeTo()
   AND COALESCE(r.finished_at, now()) >= $__timeFrom()
   AND ('__all' IN ($realm) OR r.realm IN ($realm))
      AND ('__all' IN ($automation) OR r.automation_id IN ($automation))
      AND ('__all' IN ($payer) OR r.acts_as IN ($payer))
      AND ('__all' IN ($trigger) OR r.trigger IN ($trigger))
 GROUP BY t
 ORDER BY t;

panels.title: Runs in flight

panels.description: For runs ending in each interval: the files each run's commit wrote, the run's callApi calls and the run's AI (resolve) calls. A Preview stages writes and commits none, so a Preview adds no writes here.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.finished_at, $__interval, 0),
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.dry_run THEN 0 ELSE r.writes END)::int AS "writes",
       SUM(r.call_api_calls)::int AS "callApi calls",
       SUM(r.resolve_calls)::int AS "resolve calls"
  FROM automation_runs r
 WHERE r.finished_at IS NOT NULL
   AND $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
   AND ('__all' IN ($realm) OR r.realm IN ($realm))
   AND ('__all' IN ($automation) OR r.automation_id IN ($automation))
   AND ('__all' IN ($payer) OR r.acts_as IN ($payer))
   AND ('__all' IN ($trigger) OR r.trigger IN ($trigger))
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Writes and calls

panels.description: For runs ending in each interval: the bytes each run's callApi calls downloaded, and the prerender tab time each run's script held: the two quantities a run's own charge prices.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.finished_at, $__interval, 0),
       SUM(r.call_api_response_bytes)::bigint AS "downloaded",
       SUM(r.prerender_tab_ms)::bigint / 1000.0 AS "prerender tab time"
  FROM automation_runs r
 WHERE r.finished_at IS NOT NULL
   AND $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
   AND ('__all' IN ($realm) OR r.realm IN ($realm))
   AND ('__all' IN ($automation) OR r.automation_id IN ($automation))
   AND ('__all' IN ($payer) OR r.acts_as IN ($payer))
   AND ('__all' IN ($trigger) OR r.trigger IN ($trigger))
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: AWS cost by kind

panels.description: Each pricing version pricing automation charges in the time range, with the version's margin, the time a process first recorded the version, and the charges, credits charged and hosting cost at the version. AI charges carry no version and show a blank one. The pricing skill explains how to read a version's values and unit rates (pricing_versions, pricing_version_rates).

targets.rawSql:
WITH charges AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(l.charge_id, l.id) AS charge_id,
         l.charge_kind,
         l.pricing_version,
         l.created_at,
         l.realm,
         l.run_id,
         COALESCE(l.automation_id, r.automation_id) AS automation_id,
         r.trigger,
         u.matrix_user_id AS payer,
         -SUM(l.credit_amount) AS credits
    FROM credits_ledger l
    LEFT JOIN automation_runs r ON r.id = l.run_id
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = l.user_id
   WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(l.created_at)
     AND (l.charge_kind IN ('run', 'run_indexing', 'storage', 'batched_ai')
          OR (l.charge_kind = 'ai' AND l.run_id IS NOT NULL))
   GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9
),
costed AS (
  SELECT charges.*, c.cost_usd
    FROM charges
    LEFT JOIN credit_charge_costs c
      ON c.charge_id = charges.charge_id
     AND $__unixEpochFilter(c.created_at)
   WHERE ('__all' IN ($realm) OR charges.realm IN ($realm))
     AND ('__all' IN ($automation) OR charges.automation_id IN ($automation))
     AND ('__all' IN ($payer) OR charges.payer IN ($payer))
     AND ('__all' IN ($trigger) OR charges.trigger IN ($trigger))
)
SELECT costed.pricing_version AS "pricing version",
       v.margin,
       to_timestamp(v.recorded_at) AS "recorded",
       COUNT(*) AS charges,
       SUM(costed.credits) AS "Credits charged",
       SUM(costed.cost_usd) AS "AWS cost",
       to_timestamp(MIN(costed.created_at)) AS "first charge",
       to_timestamp(MAX(costed.created_at)) AS "last charge"
  FROM costed
  LEFT JOIN pricing_versions v ON v.version = costed.pricing_version
 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
 ORDER BY "last charge" DESC;

panels.title: Pricing versions

panels.description: The cost coverage report over the dashboard's time range: for each charge kind and pricing version, the credits charged beside the hosting cost of the usage the charges priced, in credits (1,000 to the dollar). Margin equals Credits charged (priced) less AWS cost; coverage says how many times the cost a kind recovered. A fully paid metered kind reads at least the version's margin, and more where rounding a small charge up to a whole credit adds credits (compare full credits with cost at margin); AI reads about 1. A negative margin or a coverage under 1 marks a kind charging less than the usage costs. Shortfall counts credits the payer's balance could not cover. The report covers every charge, not only automation charges, and the dashboard's filters do not narrow the report. The pricing skill's "The cost coverage report" explains each column.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT charge_kind, pricing_version,
       COUNT(*) AS charges,
       SUM(credits) AS credits,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_usd IS NOT NULL) AS priced_charges,
       SUM(credits) FILTER (WHERE cost_usd IS NOT NULL) AS priced_credits,
       SUM(cost_usd) * 1000 AS cost_credits,
       SUM(cost_usd * margin) * 1000 AS cost_at_margin_credits,
       SUM(full_credits) AS full_credits,
       SUM(credits) FILTER (WHERE cost_usd IS NOT NULL)
         - SUM(cost_usd) * 1000 AS margin_credits,
       SUM(credits) FILTER (WHERE cost_usd IS NOT NULL)
         / NULLIF(SUM(cost_usd) * 1000, 0) AS coverage,
       SUM(unpaid_credits) AS shortfall_credits,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE unpaid_credits > 0) AS short_charged_charges
FROM credit_charge_costs
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2 NULLS FIRST;

panels.title: Cost coverage

panels.description: Each switched-on automation the filters match, with the automation's current state and the automation's runs, errors, credits charged and AWS cost in the time range. Payer names the person each scheduled run acts as and charges. The automation column shows the card's path inside the realm, and the realm column shows the realm's path on the realm server.

targets.rawSql:
WITH charges AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(l.charge_id, l.id) AS charge_id,
         l.charge_kind,
         l.pricing_version,
         l.created_at,
         l.realm,
         l.run_id,
         COALESCE(l.automation_id, r.automation_id) AS automation_id,
         r.trigger,
         u.matrix_user_id AS payer,
         -SUM(l.credit_amount) AS credits
    FROM credits_ledger l
    LEFT JOIN automation_runs r ON r.id = l.run_id
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = l.user_id
   WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(l.created_at)
     AND (l.charge_kind IN ('run', 'run_indexing', 'storage', 'batched_ai')
          OR (l.charge_kind = 'ai' AND l.run_id IS NOT NULL))
   GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9
),
costed AS (
  SELECT charges.*, c.cost_usd
    FROM charges
    LEFT JOIN credit_charge_costs c
      ON c.charge_id = charges.charge_id
     AND $__unixEpochFilter(c.created_at)
   WHERE ('__all' IN ($realm) OR charges.realm IN ($realm))
     AND ('__all' IN ($automation) OR charges.automation_id IN ($automation))
     AND ('__all' IN ($payer) OR charges.payer IN ($payer))
     AND ('__all' IN ($trigger) OR charges.trigger IN ($trigger))
),
runs AS (
  SELECT r.automation_id,
         COUNT(*) AS runs,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.state = 'error') AS errors,
         MAX(r.created_at) AS last_run
    FROM automation_runs r
   WHERE $__timeFilter(r.created_at)
     AND ('__all' IN ($realm) OR r.realm IN ($realm))
     AND ('__all' IN ($automation) OR r.automation_id IN ($automation))
     AND ('__all' IN ($payer) OR r.acts_as IN ($payer))
     AND ('__all' IN ($trigger) OR r.trigger IN ($trigger))
   GROUP BY 1
),
spend AS (
  SELECT automation_id, SUM(credits) AS credits, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_usd
    FROM costed GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT CASE WHEN starts_with(a.automation_id, a.realm) THEN substr(a.automation_id, length(a.realm) + 1)
            ELSE a.automation_id END AS automation,
       REGEXP_REPLACE(a.realm, '^https?://[^/]+/', '') AS realm,
       a.payer,
       a.state,
       a.pause_reason AS "pause reason",
       a.next_run AS "next run",
       COALESCE(runs.runs, 0) AS runs,
       COALESCE(runs.errors, 0) AS errors,
       COALESCE(spend.credits, 0) AS "Credits charged",
       spend.cost_usd AS "AWS cost",
       a.last_finished_at AS "last finished",
       a.last_result AS "last result"
  FROM automations a
  LEFT JOIN runs ON runs.automation_id = a.automation_id
  LEFT JOIN spend ON spend.automation_id = a.automation_id
 WHERE ('__all' IN ($realm) OR a.realm IN ($realm))
   AND ('__all' IN ($automation) OR a.automation_id IN ($automation))
   AND ('__all' IN ($payer) OR a.payer IN ($payer))
 ORDER BY COALESCE(runs.last_run, a.last_finished_at) DESC NULLS LAST
 LIMIT 500;

panels.title: Automations

panels.description: The latest runs the filters match, newest first. Each row shows the automation, trigger, realm and payer (the person the run acts as and charges), the run's state and error, queue wait and run time, writes, and the credits the run's charges drew with the AWS cost and pricing version. The last index pass of a run writes the run's indexing charge, so a recent run's credits can still grow. The automation-diagnostics skill walks from a run id to the run's job, log, milestones and charges.

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT r.*
    FROM automation_runs r
   WHERE $__timeFilter(r.created_at)
     AND ('__all' IN ($realm) OR r.realm IN ($realm))
     AND ('__all' IN ($automation) OR r.automation_id IN ($automation))
     AND ('__all' IN ($payer) OR r.acts_as IN ($payer))
     AND ('__all' IN ($trigger) OR r.trigger IN ($trigger))
   ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
   LIMIT 500
),
charges AS (
  SELECT l.run_id,
         COALESCE(l.charge_id, l.id) AS charge_id,
         MAX(l.pricing_version) AS pricing_version,
         -SUM(l.credit_amount) AS credits
    FROM credits_ledger l
   WHERE l.run_id IN (SELECT id FROM runs)
   GROUP BY 1, 2
),
per_run AS (
  SELECT charges.run_id,
         SUM(charges.credits) AS credits,
         SUM(c.cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
         string_agg(DISTINCT charges.pricing_version, ', ') AS pricing_versions
    FROM charges
    LEFT JOIN credit_charge_costs c
      ON c.charge_id = charges.charge_id
     AND c.created_at >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM runs))::integer
   GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT runs.created_at AS created,
       CASE WHEN starts_with(runs.automation_id, runs.realm) THEN substr(runs.automation_id, length(runs.realm) + 1)
            ELSE runs.automation_id END AS automation,
       runs.trigger,
       REGEXP_REPLACE(runs.realm, '^https?://[^/]+/', '') AS realm,
       runs.acts_as AS payer,
       CASE WHEN runs.dry_run THEN runs.state || ' (preview)' ELSE runs.state END AS state,
       runs.error_reason AS "error reason",
       q.queue_wait_s AS "queue wait",
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM runs.finished_at - runs.started_at) AS "run time",
       runs.writes,
       COALESCE(per_run.credits, 0) AS "Credits charged",
       per_run.cost_usd AS "AWS cost",
       per_run.pricing_versions AS "pricing version",
       runs.error_message AS "error message",
       runs.id AS run
  FROM runs
  LEFT JOIN per_run ON per_run.run_id = runs.id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MIN(jr.created_at) - MIN(j.created_at)) AS queue_wait_s
      FROM jobs j
      JOIN job_reservations jr ON jr.job_id = j.id
     WHERE j.concurrency_group = 'automation:' || runs.automation_id
       AND j.args->'commandInput'->>'runId' = runs.id::text
  ) q ON true
 ORDER BY runs.created_at DESC;

panels.title: Runs (latest 500)

panels.description: Each prerender server's run tabs, from the capacity line each server writes every 30 seconds while the server holds a run tab: runningRuns (runs the server runs at once, one per tab), queuedRuns (runs waiting for a tab another run of the same realm and identity holds) and runTabs. A server holding no run tab writes no line, so a gap means an idle server. Loki scans every prerender line in the window to find the capacity lines, so the panel covers the last hour; widen the window with care.

targets.expr: max by (instance) (max_over_time({service="prerender", env="$env"} |= "boxel:automation-runs" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:automation-runs" | kind="capacity" | unwrap runningRuns [$__interval]))

max by (instance) (max_over_time({service="prerender", env="$env"} |= "boxel:automation-runs" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:automation-runs" | kind="capacity" | unwrap queuedRuns [$__interval]))

max by (instance) (max_over_time({service="prerender", env="$env"} |= "boxel:automation-runs" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:automation-runs" | kind="capacity" | unwrap runTabs [$__interval]))
